sources.profile: Fixed White_Space scalar list, Unicode-scalar CER and ordinal whitespace-delimited WER without normalization

decisions: Model identity binds explicit ordered aliases/version/content digests/length; deployment independently verifies exact assets and native loaded-language set.
CER/WER thresholds are explicit prior caller declarations; exact model versions stay separate; engine confidence never qualifies correctness.
All-blank groups cannot pass; insertions and exact Unicode differences remain visible.
